facts.fact: Tele-MANAS, the national 24x7 tele-mental health counselling service, can be reached on the toll-free number 14416
facts.quote: through 24x7 tele-mental health counselling services. For this, a toll-free number (14416) has been set up across the country.

facts.fact: 112 is the integrated emergency helpline (ERSS: police, fire and rescue, health services)
facts.quote: 112 Loading... Integrated Helpline (Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) Police, Fire & Rescue, Health services etc)

summary: Help numbers named in the expected answer confirmed: Tele-MANAS 14416 (24x7, toll-free; PIB/MoHFW) and 112 (ERSS, india.gov.in helpline directory).
